sketch1.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Coincident", 1, 1, 2, 0))

sketch1.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Coincident", 3, 1, 0, 0))

sketch1.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("DistanceY", 1, 32.0))  # Height
